def shape_transform(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); color=next(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,9))
 coords=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
 r0=min(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords)
 shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in coords}; hh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; ww=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
 out=[row[:] for row in g]
 for i in range(h-hh+1):
  for j in range(w-ww+1):
   if all(g[i+r][j+c]==0 for r,c in shape):
    for r,c in shape:out[i+r][j+c]=color
 return out
out2=shape_transform(grid)
print(sum(v==1 for row in out2 for v in row))
